      tiger among men, challenge him that can draw the bow with his left hand,
      and heroic Arjuna also will surely encounter thee in fight. But when
      furnished with thy ear-rings, Arjuna will never be able to vanquish thee
      in fight even if Indra himself comes to his assistance. Therefore, O
      Karna, if thou wishest to vanquish Arjuna in battle, these handsome
      ear-rings of thine should never be parted with to Sakra.’”
